subject: Auralix exec demo alignment and timing
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@auralix.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec demo request — Redwood inference

Hi Irene,

Hope you’re well — I’m Elaine (Head of Platform Partnerships at Auralix). We’re evaluating options to replace an aging in-house inference layer and would love a short exec-level demo of Redwood for our leadership team (VP of Engineering + CTO). The goal is to see production latency/cost targets, privacy options (VPC/on-prem), and a high-level migration plan.

Proposed window: any 30–45 minute slot the week of Mar 18–22. Our VP (Michael Zhou) prefers mornings PT; CTO can be flexible but would need at least 30 minutes. Could you propose 2 slots?

Also looping in procurement for initial docs — procurement@auralix.com.

Thanks — Elaine

Elaine Park
Head of Platform Partnerships, Auralix
elaine.park@auralix.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodai.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@auralix.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Mar 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — Redwood inference

Hi Elaine — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the context. Tessa (AE) and Sofia (Solutions Engineer) are on the thread; we’ll run the demo and cover the migration sketch you mentioned.

Quick plan: 1) 30–40 minute exec demo focused on performance/cost and private deployment options, 2) 10–15 minute Q&A about compliance and integration patterns. If you need a deeper technical breakout we can follow with an SE-led session.

Available slots we can hold for leadership:
- Tue Mar 19, 09:30–10:15 PT
- Wed Mar 20, 11:00–11:45 PT

If neither works, we can also do Thu Mar 21 08:00–08:45 PT for Michael’s morning preference. Which of these would you like us to tentatively reserve?

We can also pre-share a short one-pager on SOC 2 + SSO and the demo deck. If procurement needs anything more formal (SLA terms / security questionnaire), we’ll route those to our security team and include a timeline for responses.

Best,
Irene

Irene Choi
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodai.com
+1 (650) 555-0123
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@auralix.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Michael Zhou <mzhou@auralix.com>, procurement@auralix.com
Date: Tue, 5 Mar 2029 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — Redwood inference

Thanks Irene — Wed Mar 20, 11:00 PT would work best for Michael and our CTO. Please hold that slot for us.

Procurement: can you confirm which docs you need ahead of the session? I’ve attached our standard PO template for timeline planning (PO_template.docx).

We’d like to see: SOC 2 Type II summary, expected timeline for private deployment (VPC), and a short migration checklist. If you can pre-send the demo deck that would be ideal.

—Elaine
From: procurement@auralix.com
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@auralix.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Mar 2029 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — Redwood inference

Hi Irene/Tessa,

Quick list from procurement/security:
- SOC 2 Type II report (summary okay pre-demo)
- Vendor security questionnaire (we’ll send the template)
- High-level network diagram for VPC/private deployment
- Bill-to / procurement contact for initial PO

If you can provide the SOC2 summary and a short SSO/SSO integration note before Wed the 20th, we’ll be able to speed approvals.

Thanks,
Auralix Procurement Team
procurement@auralix.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodai.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@auralix.com>, Michael Zhou <mzhou@auralix.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodai.com>, procurement@auralix.com
Date: Thu, 7 Mar 2029 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — Redwood inference

Hi all — Wed Mar 20, 11:00–11:45 PT is confirmed on our side and tentatively on yours per Elaine. We’ve attached the demo deck and a SOC 2 Type II summary to this thread (redwood-demo-deck-v1.pptx; SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf). Tessa will be the primary point for scheduling follow-ups, and Sofia will run a 15-minute tech appendix if the CTO wants deeper detail.

Action items pre-demo:
- Tessa: send calendar invite + video link to the list (today)
- Redwood SEs: short SSO integration note (SAML/SAML2 and OIDC options) — attached below (SAML_SSO_integration.md)
- Auralix procurement: if possible, send vendor security questionnaire by Mon Mar 18 so we can route responses before the call

If anything changes on your side please flag here and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to the conversation.

Best,
Irene
